rows.title: Credit Rating- Revision
rows.summary: The international credit rating agency S&P Global Ratings has upgraded Sammaan Capital Limited s long-term [International] credit rating to  BB-  with Stable Outlook.The rating upgrade reflects the continued strengthening of the Company's credit profile following the strategic investment by International Holding Company PJSC (IHC). S&P expects an improvement in business profile, enhanced funding access, continued strong capitalization, and increase in profitability.With CRISIL having upgraded the Company s long-term rating to  CRISIL AA+/Stable  on April 9, 2026, CARE Ratings having upgraded the Company s long-term rating to  CARE AA+; Stable  on May 12, 2026, and ICRA having upgraded the Company s long-term rating to  [ICRA]AA+/Stable  on May 20, 2026, all the major rating agencies covering the Company have now upgraded their ratings following IHC s investment in the Company on March 31, 2026.The successive rating upgrades have already translated into improved market confidence and a meaningful reduction in the Company s incremental borrowing costs. Enhanced funding access and a lower cost of funds will strengthen the Company s competitive position, support higher disbursements and accelerate execution of its growth strategy.

rows.title: Updates
rows.summary: Sammaan Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Sammaan Capital Limited (SCL), an IHC group company, was upgraded to CRISIL AA+/Stable on 10 April 2026, marking the beginning of an upward rating trajectory across the rating universe, for the Company. The upward trajectory will materially reduce SCL s cost of funds and enable access to significantly larger and longer-tenor funding pools.The Asset Liability Management Committee (ALCO) of SCL, as part of its ongoing efforts to reduce the cost of funds and optimise the liability profile, has approved the acquisition of NCDs, as specified in the Annexure. The securities can be tendered at par through the exchange mechanism. The NCDs so acquired will be held by the Company as treasury stock until maturity.This initiative reflects the Company s disciplined approach to liquidity and liability management through proactive Asset-Liability Management (ALM) practices. The Company maintains a strong liquidity buffer to meet near-to mid-term obligations and, where appropriate, deploys surplus liquidity toward prepayment or buyback of outstanding debt, thereby reducing the overall cost of funds. This marks the start of a structured liability management programme aimed at reducing cost of funds, rebalancing obligations, improving maturity alignment, and reinforcing financial flexibility and balance sheet strength. Holders of the specified NCDs who wish to participate in this offer may write to bondpurchase@sammaancapital.com at any time prior to May 15, 2026, to initiate the transaction process'.For details refer attached PDF file.
